description:
Armored Core 3 is a 2002 third-person shooter video game developed by FromSoftware for the PlayStation 2.
It is the sixth entry in the Armored Core series.

v0.1.0.description:
# v0.1.0 - First Release of Armored Core 3 (PCSX2) APWorld

What Has Been Added
---
Goal Options
---
* **Progressive Missions:** Missions are unlocked in chunks of 5, approximately following the story order. Complete **Infiltrate Layered Hub** to reach the goal.
* **Missionsanity:** Each mission becomes its own check. You can choose how many missions must be completed to reach the goal.

Filler
---
* **Credits:** Credits are included as filler items. An option determines how many Credits you receive when you obtain a Credits item.
v0.1.0.title: v0.1.0 - Armored Core 3 (PCSX2) APWorld

v0.1.1.description:
# v0.1.1 - Armored Core 3 (PCSX2) APWorld

## Bug Fixes

* Receiving Bonus Credits while your total Credits are negative no longer causes an error. Credits will now be added correctly.
* Bonus Credits received before selecting or creating a save file are no longer applied until a save file has been loaded.
* The Missionsanity goal requirement option now generates when choosing to complete all 49 missions.
v0.1.1.title: v0.1.1 - Armored Core 3 (PCSX2) APWorld
